_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Uri mchezaji {player_id}, ukina {num_rounds} mizunguko ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ufite ${pool} kugawanya mzunguko huu kati yawe na mchezaji {other_id}.

Mchezaji anayehitaji:
  - Hitimisho: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiyakubaliwa → Ufite $(pool - X), mchezaji wundi afite $X
  - Ikiyakatwa → Wote mabili afite $0
  - Urugero: [Offer: $3]  cyangwa  'Ndabyumva ni sawa. [Offer: $5]'

Mchezaji anayejibu:
  - Uamuzi kuhusu hitimisho kwa [Accept] cyangwa [Reject]
  - Urugero: 'Birahabiri. [Accept]'
            'Sibyo. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mzunguko {round_number} unanza! ---
Mwari {proposer_id} ni mtoaji, Mwari {responder_id} ni mjibu.
round.accepted: Mwari {responder_id} amekubali! Mzunguko {round_number} unaongeza: Mwari {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mwari {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Mwari 0: ${total_0}, Mwari 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mwari {responder_id} amekanusha ofa hiyo! Mzunguko {round_number} unaongeza: Wachezaji wote +$0. Jumla huwa: Mwari 0: ${total_0}, Mwari 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Uwutanga igiteramo ategerezwa gutanga ikiganiro akoresheje uburyo [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Igitigiri c'ivyo batanga gitegerezwa kuba ari igiharuro ciza.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Igiciro gitegerezwa kuba kiri hagati y'amadolari 0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Nta kintu na kimwe kiriko kiraba muri iki gihe co kwishura.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Umufunguzi lazima aweke [Accept] au [Reject] ofa hiyo.

outcome.win: Mwari {winner} ameshinda na ${winner_total} jumla dhidi ya Mwari {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Abakinyi bompi barangije n'amahera ${total} yose hamwe.
